Who we are

A Swiss team with more than twenty years of experience building bridges between markets.

Approach

How a mandate proceeds

  1. 01

    Confidential conversation

    In confidence, without obligation.

  2. 02

    Assessment and mandate

    Feasibility check and a written mandate.

  3. 03

    Preparation

    Structuring and investor-ready materials.

  4. 04

    Targeted outreach

    A selected group of qualified counterparties.

  5. 05

    Negotiation and close

    Through to signed agreements.

Typical mandates

Illustrative scenarios, not client references

Capital raising

Funding a public infrastructure project

A government has part of the funding for a major project. We are mandated to raise the rest from international investors.

Sponsorship

A professional basketball player needs a brand partner. We are mandated to find the sponsor and negotiate the deal.
